description: Replace an unsigned quote with a new version. Earlier signing links stop working; send it again for a new link.

kind.description: item (default), fee (trip charge, disposal, card fee) or discount. For a discount, enter the amount off as a positive unit_price_minor.

option_key.description: Put this line only in the option with this key. Leave out for a line shared by every option.

optional.description: The customer can add or leave out this line when signing.

taxable.description: Counts toward tax when the quote or invoice has a tax rate. Default true.

options.description: Good, better, best: 2 to 5 options the customer chooses one of when signing. Each needs its own lines.

tax_rate_id.description: Tax rate to charge (taxes.listRates). Leave out to use the shop default rate; null for no tax.

name: quotes_revise
